sources.title: Enhancing cancer symptom detection in electronic health records using ...
sources.snippet: The study introduces Symptom-BERT, a domain-specific AI model that detects cancer symptoms at broad (document-level) and granular (token-level) scales. It also explores fine-tuning and prompt-based learning approaches to adapt AI models to the nuanced language of clinical care.

sources.title: Detecting Belly Button Cancer Symptoms | PDF | Medical Diagnosis ...
sources.snippet: The study presents Symptom-BERT, a pretrained language model designed to enhance the detection of cancer symptoms in electronic health records (EHR). It achieved a micro-averaged F1-score of 0.933 and demonstrated superior performance compared to existing BERT models, particularly in identifying physical symptoms over psychological ones.
